plan.title: Delete one of two single-stage RFQ rows

steps.note: Opens the Single Stage create screen.
Changes the event type from the default RFP to RFQ.
Applies the RFQ template so the product sheet is available.

args.goal: On the RFQ single-stage product sheet, add the first row with product CYLINDER and variant CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB so Product Variant becomes Default Variant, set Quantity Requested to 10, choose delivery location Plant Name (LOC-0001), add a second row, hover the first row, click its bin/delete control and confirm deletion, then stop with the sheet visibly showing one remaining row and the updated totals and automatic title.

steps.note: Performs the product-specific sheet interactions, row deletion, confirmation, and verifies the resulting title and totals on screen.
Asserts that exactly one product row remains after deletion.
